title: Evaluation of the Efficacy of an inTerdialytic "Ethanol 40% v/v - enoxapaRin 1000 U/mL" Lock solutioN to Prevent Tunnelled Catheter Infections in Chronic Hemodialysis Patients
official: Evaluation of the Efficacy of an inTerdialytic "Ethanol 40% v/v - enoxapaRin 1000 U/mL" Lock solutioN to Prevent Tunnelled Catheter Infections in Chronic Hemodialysis Patients: a mulTi-centre, Randomized, Single Blind, Parallel Group studY (ETERNITY)
summary: The purpose of this study is to assessed the efficacy of a combined solution of ethanol (4%) and low molecular weight heparins LMWH in preventing tunnelled dialysis catheter infection in chronic hemodialysis patients
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* end-stage renal disease
* chronic hemodialysis/hemodiafiltration at least three times a week
* functional TC inserted for at least two weeks
* Social security cover
* Written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
